sentence: a fox runs through a burning forest jumping over fallen logs and grabbing acorns

answer.plan: Endless run through the forest; the logs are obstacles, acorns the coins.
answer.title: Fox on Fire
answer.goal: Run through the forest, jump the logs and grab acorns.

sentence: a mouse runs from a cat through the kitchen dodging pots

answer.plan: Runner with a chaser behind; pots are the obstacles.
answer.title: Kitchen Getaway
answer.goal: Dodge the pots and outrun the cat.

sentence: a robot jumps across factory platforms and shoots rust bugs

answer.plan: Platformer; shooting is the second verb, so the shoot addon.
answer.title: Rust Buster
answer.goal: Jump across the platforms and shoot the rust bugs.

sentence: an astronaut hops between moon craters collecting crystals

answer.plan: Platformer on the moon; crystals are the coins.
answer.title: Crater Hopper
answer.goal: Hop between the craters and collect the crystals.

sentence: a paper plane flutters between skyscrapers collecting stars

answer.plan: Flap through gaps; skyscrapers are the pipes.
answer.title: Paper Plane

sentence: race a snowmobile down a glacier past other riders and grab speed boosts

answer.plan: Racing: rivals are the other riders, turbo the speed boosts.

answer.goal: Race down the glacier past the other riders.

sentence: fly a biplane through the canyon and dodge the rocks

answer.plan: Steer the plane; rocks are the barriers.

sentence: a tiny jellyfish eats plankton and grows while sharks hunt it

answer.plan: Eat and grow; sharks are the hunters, plankton the food.

sentence: defend the space station by shooting down asteroids

answer.plan: Tap to shoot; asteroids are the enemies.

answer.goal: Shoot down the asteroids before they hit the station.

sentence: a pirate ship fires cannonballs at sea monsters and has three lives

answer.plan: Shooter at sea; three lives is the lives addon.

sentence: throw snowballs at a snowman in the park

answer.plan: Hold and release to throw; the snowman is the target.

sentence: stack pancakes as high as you can in a diner

answer.plan: Stop the bar to stack; pancakes are the blocks.

answer.goal: Stack the pancakes as high as you can.

sentence: tap to the beat of the drums at a beach party

answer.plan: Rhythm: each drum beat is a note.
answer.title: Drum Beach

sentence: a samurai duels a ninja on a temple roof

answer.plan: One-on-one fight: the ninja is the rival.

sentence: a squirrel collects five nuts in the garden and hides in its tree

sentence: sneak past the guard dogs to reach the treasure room

answer.plan: Grid walk past patrols; the treasure room is the exit.

sentence: carry the lost puppy back to its kennel in the park

answer.goal: Carry the puppy back to its kennel.

sentence: take the silver key and open the treasure chest on a pirate island

answer.plan: Walk the island; taking and opening are verbs move_free cannot play, so rules add them.
